title: Chicken and Mushroom Pie
subtitle: Creamy filling under a golden shortcrust or puff pastry lid
excerpt: Tender chicken thigh, chestnut mushrooms, and leek in a tarragon cream sauce, topped with a buttery shortcrust lid and baked until deep golden. A proper British main course pie.

recipe.sourceNotes: Chicken and mushroom pie is one of the most beloved pies in British cooking, found in both home kitchens and pub menus. The filling uses a veloute-style sauce: chicken stock thickened with a flour and butter roux, enriched with cream. Chicken thigh is preferable to breast as it stays moist through baking. Tarragon is the classic British pairing with chicken in creamy sauces. A shortcrust pastry lid is traditional; puff pastry gives a flakier result.

recipeTools.notes: Or a deep 23 cm pie dish.

content.text: The filling must be completely cool before the pastry lid goes on: a hot filling steams the pastry from underneath and prevents it crisping. Brush the rim of the dish with beaten egg before pressing the pastry down, and brush the top generously. Cut a small hole in the centre for steam to escape.

items.preparation: boneless skinless, cut into 3 cm pieces

content.text: Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Fry the onion and leek for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and mushrooms. Cook for 3 minutes until the mushrooms soften. Push to the sides of the pan.

Add the chicken pieces and cook for 4 minutes until sealed. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually pour in the chicken stock, stirring constantly. Bring to a simmer. Add the cream and tarragon. Season with salt and pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens and the chicken is cooked through.
Pour the filling into a deep pie dish. Leave to cool for 20 minutes. Heat the oven to 200 C / fan 180 C / gas 6.

Brush the rim of the dish with beaten egg. Lay the pastry over the top. Press the edges to seal. Trim the excess. Brush with beaten egg. Cut a small hole in the centre. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until the pastry is deep golden.
